name: Amanera
positioning: Aman's beachfront golf resort on the north coast of the Dominican Republic, with casita wellness treatments and beach dining
best_for: Travelers who want golf and beach time at one resort
Couples who want private beach dinners and wellness rituals
Families with children who like a daily Kids' Club

facts.text: Amanera is a 75-minute drive from Puerto Plata Airport.
The Chef's Table offers Mediterranean, Peruvian and Dominican menus.
The restaurants are open to Aman guests and to non-residents, subject to availability.
Amanera's rummeliers lead a rum masterclass that pairs rums with organic chocolate.
The wellness offering includes an Open-Air Wellness Platform with ocean views.
Wellness treatments can be taken in the casita.
Beachside Wellness lets guests enjoy signature spa therapies in private beach cabanas.
Guests have access to the Playa Grande Golf Course.
The accommodation page lists use of bikes and of all non-motorised watersports equipment among the stay inclusions.
A daily Kids' Club offers arts and crafts activities such as pottery making, nature watching and face painting.

highlights.text: The Sunset Coastal Boat Tour sails through Laguna Gri-Gri past mangroves and bird sanctuaries.
Amanera is the second Aman resort in the Caribbean and the Aman brand's first golf resort.
Humpback whales can be seen from mid-January to mid-March, and the resort offers a private day-long boat tour to Samana to see them.
Guests can take a private cigar class led by Juan Alberto, Amanera's Maestro del Cigarro.
Amanera offers a private beach dinner served by a dedicated waiter beside a bonfire.

considerations.text: The resort is a 75-minute drive from Puerto Plata Airport.
Humpback whale watching is seasonal, from mid-January to mid-March.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires planning for off-property activities.
